nuance: Sections' existing create/rename/reorder/archive/delete (built in #171) is reachable and consistent with this ticket's own new Project/Label controls

create.entryPoint: 'Add section' button on the project page
create.controlType: inline editor — input[aria-label='Name this section'] plus a tiptap Description field, submitted by a second 'Add section' button beside Cancel

rename.controlType: INLINE, prefilled input[aria-label='Name this section'] — not a modal

sectionMenu.openedFrom: the section header's own 'More actions' button, revealed on hover

todoist.reorderAffordance: 'Move to…' in the section menu; drag is Todoist's usual section reorder and was NOT driven here

meologue.sectionsHeading: Sections (1/20) — meologue caps sections at 20 per Project; no equivalent cap was observed in Todoist

create.entryPoint: inline form — input[aria-label="New Section's name"] plus an 'Add Section' button

rename.controlType: inline text field on the section row (the same rename-on-blur shape the Label and Project rows use)

confirmationDialog.bodyFullText: This destroys 0 Tasks in this Section, completed ones included. This cannot be undone — unlike Archive, which keeps every Task, just completed. The only way back is whenever you last ran an Export by hand.
confirmationDialog.note: Cancelled, not confirmed — the section went away with the project.

verdict.affordanceSet: MATCH — create, rename, reorder, archive and delete are all present and reachable on both sides, which is this row's actual claim.
verdict.createAndRenameShape: MATCH, and unusually so: Todoist's section create and rename are BOTH inline rather than modal, which is exactly meologue's shape. Sections are the one structural object where the two apps agree on the surface as well as the capability.
verdict.reorder: DIVERGENT — Todoist offers 'Move to…' and drag; meologue offers explicit 'Move earlier' / 'Move later' buttons. meologue's is keyboard-operable, Todoist's drag is not.
verdict.deleteWording: DIVERGENT, and deliberately out of scope — meologue's section dialog counts the Tasks it will destroy and contrasts Archive, wording that predates the verbatim Todoist table this ticket works from. Todoist's own section-delete wording was NOT captured (the menu item was read, not clicked), so this sub-clause stays one-sided by choice.
verdict.consistencyWithNewControls: MATCH — the section row uses the same inline rename-on-blur and per-row-button shape as the new Label and Project rows, which is what the nuance asks for.
verdict.reason: The affordance set matches in full; reorder mechanism and delete wording differ, both recorded.
